mapper.insert: INSERT INTO outbox_events ( event_id, aggregate_type, aggregate_id, event_type, schema_version, event_version, topic, kafka_key, payload_json, trace_id, status, retry_count, next_retry_at, created_at ) VALUES ( #{eventId}, #{aggregateType}, #{aggregateId}, #{eventType}, #{schemaVersion}, #{eventVersion}, #{topic}, #{kafkaKey}, #{payloadJson}, #{traceId}, #{status}, 0, #{nextRetryAt}, #{createdAt} )
mapper.select: SELECT o.id, o.event_id, o.aggregate_type, o.aggregate_id, o.event_type, o.schema_version, o.event_version, o.topic, o.kafka_key, o.payload_json, o.trace_id, o.status, o.retry_count, o.next_retry_at, o.claimed_by, o.claimed_until, o.published_at, o.created_at FROM outbox_events o WHERE ( ( o.status = 'PENDING' AND ( o.next_retry_at IS NULL OR o.next_retry_at <= NOW(6) ) ) OR ( o.status = 'PROCESSING' AND o.claimed_until < NOW(6) ) ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM outbox_events older WHERE older.aggregate_type = o.aggregate_type AND older.aggregate_id = o.aggregate_id AND older.event_version < o.event_version AND older.status != 'PUBLISHED' ) ORDER BY o.id LIMIT #{limit} FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
mapper.update: UPDATE outbox_events SET status = 'PUBLISHED', published_at = #{publishedAt}, claimed_by = NULL, claimed_until = NULL WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PROCESSING' AND claimed_by = #{claimedBy}

UPDATE outbox_events SET status = 'PENDING', retry_count = retry_count + 1, next_retry_at = #{nextRetryAt}, claimed_by = NULL, claimed_until = NULL WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PROCESSING' AND claimed_by = #{claimedBy}
